_comment: Upmc - performance-focused Purpur/Paper fork egg. Requires Java 25. Import via Admin Panel > Nests > (select a nest) > Import Egg.
name: Upmc
author: MrFrenchGuy23
description: Upmc a fork for Minecraft 26.2 focused on high performance for low budget servers. needs Java 25 (ghcr.io/pterodactyl/yolks:java_25).

installation.script:
#@!/bin/bash
# Upmc egg install script - server jar + bundled plugins
set -e

if [ ! -d /mnt/server ]; then
  mkdir -p /mnt/server
fi
cd /mnt/server

# --- Upmc server jar ---
if [ -z "${SERVER_JAR_URL}" ]; then
  echo -e "No download URL set. Upload upmc.jar manually via the File Manager."
else
  echo -e "Downloading Upmc server jar..."
  curl -sSL -o "${SERVER_JAR}" "${SERVER_JAR_URL}"
  if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo -e "Server jar download failed. Check the URL."
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# Accept EULA
echo -e "eula=true" > eula.txt

# --- Plugins ---
mkdir -p plugins

dl() {
  local url="$1" dest="$2"
  echo -e "  > ${dest}"
  curl -sSL -o "plugins/${dest}" "${url}" || echo -e "  WARNING: failed to download ${dest}"
}

# ViaVersion family: lets 1.7.6 - 1.12.2 and up clients join a 26.2 server.
# ViaBackwards handles 1.9.4-1.12.2 clients, ViaRewind handles 1.7.6-1.8.9.
echo -e "Installing ViaVersion family..."
dl "https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/P1OZGk5p/versions/N1tHqKId/ViaVersion-5.12.0-SNAPSHOT.jar" "ViaVersion.jar"
dl "https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/NpvuJQoq/versions/D2klj0m6/ViaBackwards-5.12.0-SNAPSHOT.jar" "ViaBackwards.jar"
dl "https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/TbHIxhx5/versions/r9d7WsYA/ViaRewind-4.1.3.jar" "ViaRewind.jar"

# Management / economy
echo -e "Installing management plugins..."
dl "https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Vebnzrzj/versions/b0mk8uS6/LuckPerms-Bukkit-5.5.71.jar" "LuckPerms.jar"
dl "https://github.com/MilkBowl/Vault/releases/download/1.7.3/Vault.jar" "Vault.jar"

# WorldGuard + WorldEdit (WorldGuard requires WorldEdit)
echo -e "Installing WorldGuard + WorldEdit..."
dl "https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/1u6JkXh5/versions/F5ea2ov3/worldedit-bukkit-7.4.5.jar" "WorldEdit.jar"
dl "https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/DKY9btbd/versions/btHBavWa/worldguard-bukkit-7.0.18.jar" "WorldGuard.jar"

# World pre-generation
echo -e "Installing Chunky..."
dl "https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/fALzjamp/versions/MdY6JATr/Chunky-Bukkit-1.5.3.jar" "Chunky.jar"

# TAB (published as a zip - extract the jar)
echo -e "Installing TAB..."
curl -sSL -o /tmp/tab.zip "https://github.com/NEZNAMY/TAB/releases/download/6.1.2/TAB.v6.1.2.zip" \
  && mkdir -p /tmp/tab && cd /tmp/tab && unzip -o /tmp/tab.zip >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  && JAR=$(find . -maxdepth 2 -name "*.jar" | head -n 1) \
  && cp "${JAR}" /mnt/server/plugins/TAB.jar \
  && echo -e "  > TAB.jar" \
  && cd /mnt/server \
  || echo -e "  WARNING: failed to install TAB"

echo -e "Install complete."

variables.name: Jar name
variables.description: The name of the Upmc jar to run. Defaults to upmc.jar - keep this in sync with the file you upload/download.

variables.name: Jar download URL
variables.description: Direct URL to the Upmc jar (e.g. a GitHub release asset). Defaults to the V1 release. Leave empty to upload the jar manually via File Manager.

variables.name: Java opts
variables.description: Aikar's flags - tuned G1GC settings for stable TPS.
